page.layout: One page of text, below a woodcut ornament. Heading with division number "I." and title above the first paragraph. No running head or page number. Signature "a 3" at the foot. Right-margin fragments at the edge of the page, likely from the neighbouring page, not transcribed.

main_text.head: I. DE REPUBLICA CARTHAGINIENSIUM.
main_text.p: EVir eodem tempore, quo floruit Lacedæmon, & sæculis proximè secutis, illustris quoque & præpotens civitas Carthaginiensis,in Africâ sita ipso in litore, cujus rempublicam liberam cum Lacedæmoniâ comparat Aristoteles, politicorum lib. ii, cap. ix. Hæc à Didone Phœnicia tyrannidem fratris Pigmalionis cum Phœnicibus aliis fugiente condita, regio imperio aliquandiu gubernata fuit. Deinde eo repudiato libertatem arripuit, ac priusquàm bene compositas res, & stabile recteque formatum statum obtineret, varios casus est perpessa, quorum plerosque compendio recitat ex Trogo Iustinus historicus libro xix, & proximè sequentibus. In formandâ verò republicâ suâ sine dubio multa mutuata fuit à conditoribus suis Tyriis, quorum[?]

page.notes: The right-hand margin shows only cut-off fragments (around "priusquàm", "stabile", "Trogo" and "proximè") and bleed from the neighbouring page; no legible marginal note could be read, so none is transcribed. The last word "quorum" is partly covered by those fragments and is marked [?]. The woodcut ornament at the top and the drop-cap "E" are joined to "Vir" as "EVir". Faint show-through at the top of the page is not transcribed.
